question: Who received the Football Writers' Association (FWA) Women's Footballer of the Year award for the 2024-25 season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alessia Russo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Alessia Russo**, a prominent English footballer, received the **Football Writers' Association (FWA) Women's Footballer of the Year award** for the 2024-25 season.
 
• She plays as a forward for **Arsenal Women** in the Women's Super League (WSL) and is an integral part of the England national team.
 
• Russo’s outstanding performances during the 2024-25 season, including her goal-scoring consistency and ability to deliver in crucial matches, earned her this prestigious award.
 
• She has been instrumental in Arsenal's success, contributing to their victories in domestic and international competitions.
 
• Her achievements also include her stellar role in England’s campaigns, further solidifying her reputation as one of the top footballers in the world.

• **Lauren James**

 
 
• Lauren James is an English footballer who plays as a forward for Chelsea in the Women’s Super League (WSL) and the England national team.
 
• She is known for her exceptional dribbling skills, creativity, and ability to score crucial goals.
 
• James played a key role in England's campaign during the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup, showcasing her immense talent.
 
 
 
• **Mariona Caldentey**
 
 
• Mariona Caldentey is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for FC Barcelona and the Spain national team.
 
• She is known for her versatility, technical ability, and vision on the field.
 
• Caldentey was a crucial part of Spain's victory in the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup and contributed significantly to Barcelona’s success in domestic and European competitions.
 
 
 
• **Khadija Shaw**
 
 
• Khadija "Bunny" Shaw is a Jamaican footballer who plays as a forward for Manchester City in the Women’s Super League (WSL) and the Jamaica national team.
 
• She is recognized for her physicality, goal-scoring prowess, and leadership on the field.
 
• Shaw was a standout performer for Jamaica during the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup, helping her team reach the knockout stages for the first time.
